claims.text: 15 to 20% cream in place of or with hydroquinone and/or tretinoin; a tyrosinase inhibitor that reduces melanin production;
claims.quote: Azelaic acid 15 to 20% cream can be used in place of or with hydroquinone and/or tretinoin. Azelaic acid is a tyrosinase inhibitor that reduces melanin production.
During pregnancy, azelaic acid 15 to 20% cream and chemical peeling with glycolic acid are safe to use.
